title: A Founder pays no finder's fee on any sale through Jan 31, 2028

source.ref: Launch milestones doc rulings 2026-11-23 (project thread: Build the Founding Year checkout; owner picked 'Start a thread now' 2026-11-25 00:09Z)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-25: the Founder fee perk is stale. Founding Businesses keep a locked 3% buy-down, and nothing waives the 10% finder's fee (capped $20, ADR-1978) for a Founding Year buyer. Owner ruling 2026-11-23: no finder's fee on anyone through January 31, 2028, replacing the old 3% promise. Fix: one pure rule in founding-year.ts that fees.ts asks, so every Space sale path (tickets, memberships, shop) charges 0 to a Founder until Feb 1, 2028.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
